title: Coverage-Driven Verification for Safety-by-Design in AI-Based Collision Avoidance Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.20864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) offers significant potential for future aviation systems; however, its integration into safety-critical applications requires compliance with the aviation sector's stringent safety standards. For AI and Machine Learning (ML)-based systems, the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) emphasizes the need to demonstrate the representativeness and completeness of the Operational Design Domain (ODD) and the associated data distributions used during development and verification. Despite this requirement, a structured engineering process for defining target distributions and evaluating representativeness within ODDs remains largely unexplored. This work presents a method for representativeness assessment of AI/ML constituent ODDs in the context of aviation safety assurance. translated_title: 基于覆盖驱动的安全设计验证：AI碰撞避免系统中的应用
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）为未来航空系统带来了巨大潜力；然而，将其集成到安全关键应用中需要符合航空领域严格的安全标准。对于基于AI和机器学习（ML）的系统，欧洲航空安全局（EASA）强调需要证明运行设计域（ODD）及相关开发与验证过程中使用的数据分布的代表性和完整性。尽管有这一要求，但用于定义目标分布和评估ODD内代表性的结构化工程流程在很大程度上仍未被探索。本工作提出了一种在航空安全保证背景下评估AI/ML组件ODD代表性的方法。从方法性地识别合适的目标分布开始，提出一个流程，指导开发者从ODD定义到验证过程。
tldr: 本文提出了一种系统化方法，用于评估AI/ML系统在航空安全中的ODD代表性，通过定义目标分布和覆盖驱动流程，确保碰撞避免系统的安全设计合规性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a systematic method for assessing the representativeness of AI/ML ODDs in aviation safety, using coverage-driven processes to define target distributions and ensure compliance in collision avoidance systems.
